snip.t: Lichen sclerosus et atrophicus (balanitis xerotica obliterans, BXO): a chronic, progressive sclerosing dermatosis of the glans and prepuce, usually in uncircumcised men: white atrophic patches, phimosis, itching, painful erections, and meatal and urethral strictures.
snip.s: Penile Conditions: Benign Lesions, Premalignant Disease and Penile Cancer
